title: Country Climate and Development Report: Ecuador
temporal_coverage: Reports historical flood and shoreline impacts, recent policy processes, and modeled climate, poverty and adaptation outcomes to 2050.
methodology: Climate scenarios, hazard models, sector analysis and poverty microsimulation.
limitations: Some impact estimates are cited; model results depend on scenarios.

title: Análisis de choques en Ecuador - 2026
organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)
temporal_coverage: Intersectoral shock analysis published May 2026; describes security-related operational constraints during 2025 and current humanitarian needs.
methodology: OCHA intersectoral analysis summarizes 2026 shock needs and access conditions.
limitations: Only the official publication-page text was accessible; the linked PDF was not opened.

title: Food security impacts of organized criminal violence in Ecuador
organization: Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET)
temporal_coverage: Special report published 29 May 2026; describes recent violence and projects food-security and weather conditions for June–December 2026.
methodology: FEWS NET combines food-security and weather analysis.
limitations: Forecast reflects May 2026 information; local outcomes may vary.
